'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***The [[Ukrainian Air Force]] launches a wave of [[Storm Shadow]] [[cruise missile]] strikes on Russian military infrastructure in [[Crimea]], with explosions reported near [[Sevastopol International Airport]]. Russia says it shot down 20 Ukrainian missiles over the [[Black Sea]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2024/01/31/ukraine-launches-storm-shadow-missile-attack-on-crimea/ (''The Telegraph'')]
**[[Russia]] and [[Ukraine]] conduct a [[prisoner exchange]] on [[Russia–Ukraine border|the border]], with 195 [[Russian Armed Forces|soldiers]] being returned to Russia, and 207 [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|military personnel]] and [[civilian]]s being returned to Ukraine, respectively. The deal was facilitated by the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-68156442 (BBC News)]
*[[Iraqi conflict]]
**[[Attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq, Jordan, and Syria (2023–present)|Attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq, Jordan, and Syria]]
***[[Kata'ib Hezbollah]] suspends operations against the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] in [[Iraq]], in order to "prevent embarrassment of the [[Federal government of Iraq|Iraqi government]]". [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iraqs-kataib-hezbollah-suspends-military-operations-us-forces-statement-2024-01-30/ (Reuters)]
